response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals), rental_store AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, rt.total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN rental_totals rt ON rt.rental_id = r.rental_id) SELECT rs.store_id, SUM(rs.total) AS total_payments, AVG(rs.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_above_average FROM rental_store rs CROSS JOIN avg_total a WHERE rs.total > a.avg_total GROUP BY rs.store_id ORDER BY rs.store_id;
